summary_en: Board reaffirms cost-of-capital management framework. Current state reassessed; improvement roadmap updated. Specific KPI targets and execution timeline disclosed in attachment.
title_en: Response to Realizing Management Focused on Cost of Capital and Share Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 23 June 2026, Nozaki Insatsu Shigyo's board resolved to reaffirm and update its cost-of-capital and stock-price-conscious management framework, originally disclosed on 25 June 2025. The company has conducted a reassessment of its current state and formulated an updated roadmap for improvement. Specific KPI targets, execution timelines, and detailed rationale are set out in the attached document (dated 23 June 2026). The filing does not disclose numerical KPI levels, payout-ratio floors, or horizon dates in the headline release; these details are reserved for the attachment.
